fields.name: ReaderIds
fields.description: IAM user ids that may read the row (server-stamped ACL).

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: ItemType
fields.description: Kind of shared item. One of: scope|screens|screen|requirements|wiki-page|preview.

fields.name: SharedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the sharer.

fields.name: SharedWithUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the recipient.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key <op>:<requestId>[:<n>], set by the server; unique index.
